{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse with a V-neck, relaxed fit, midi length, ivory, #FFFFF0.
Wool crepe trousers with a wide leg, tailored silhouette, mid-calf length, charcoal grey, #36454F.
Cashmere textured blazer, single-breasted cut with notched lapels, hip length, deep emerald green, #04692D.
Leather ankle boots with a low block heel, sleek pointy toe, chestnut brown, #5C4033.
Gold-plated drop earrings, medium size, polished finish, #FFD700.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for a Saturday evening birthday party by blending professional polish with social elegance. The emerald green blazer anchors the look in sophistication while the relaxed silk blouse keeps it comfortable and approachable for celebration. The wide-leg trousers add a modern fluidity that complements the autumn season, and the chestnut boots ensure you can move freely through the festivities without sacrificing style."}
